en.headline: Customs seize 12.4 kg of suspected ketamine in air parcel, arrest woman in Kwun Tong
en.dek: Officers found the drugs hidden in plastic buckets declared as swimming-pool sanitisers arriving from Spain via France; a 23-year-old local woman was detained after a controlled delivery.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it seized about 12.4 kilograms of suspected ketamine with an estimated market value of more than HK$5 million from an air parcel at Hong Kong International Airport on Monday.

Through risk assessment, officers inspected a consignment that arrived from Spain via France and was declared as swimming-pool sanitisers. The suspected drugs were found inside four plastic buckets inside the parcel.
After follow-up investigation, Customs conducted a controlled delivery operation on Tuesday and arrested a 23-year-old local woman in Kwun Tong. The case remains under investigation.

Customs said it would continue to combat drug trafficking through intelligence analysis and reminded the public not to accept requests to carry or receive unknown parcels for monetary reward. Trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關檢獲12.4公斤懷疑氯胺酮 觀塘拘23歲女子
zh.dek: 空運包裹報稱為泳池消毒劑，內藏膠桶裝懷疑K仔，市值逾500萬元；關員監控遞送後於觀塘拘捕本地女子。
body: 香港海關表示，周一在香港國際機場檢獲約12.4公斤懷疑氯胺酮，估計市值超過500萬港元。
關員透過風險評估查驗一件由西班牙經法國抵港、報稱載有游泳池消毒劑的空運包裹，在包裹內四個膠桶發現該批懷疑毒品。
經跟進調查後，海關周二採取監控遞送行動，在觀塘拘捕一名23歲本地女子。案件仍在調查中。
海關表示會繼續根據情報分析打擊販毒活動，並呼籲市民切勿貪圖金錢利益協助運送不明包裹。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
